title: A Large Scale Analysis of Gender Biases in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from 3,217 gender-neutral prompts across everyday activities, contexts, objects, and occupations, automatically classifying the perceived binary gender of the generated people using an object detector and an MLLM, and calculating female-to-male ratios to measure stereotype reinforcement and bias amplification against baseline datasets (LAION-400M) and U.S. labor statistics.

Using an MLLM to classify the perceived race of individuals in the generated images into distinct categories to evaluate the overall racial distribution, revealing an overrepresentation of white individuals and the presence of cultural stereotypes in specific prompts.

Using an MLLM to classify the perceived age of individuals in the generated images into decade-based brackets to evaluate age representation, revealing a heavy skew towards generating young adults (ages 20-39).
